summary: The ProgramYearType class is responsible for managing program year data within the HSPnet system. It provides functionalities to retrieve a list of program years based on session and program details.
purpose: To handle and provide structured data related to program years for educational programs in the HSPnet system.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: A unique identifier for the program year.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The display value for the program year.

actors.description: Represents a session in the HSPnet system that is used to retrieve configuration settings and program details.

workflows.name: Retrieve Program Year List
steps: Check if the session (sess) is not null.
Look up the maximum program year from the configuration using the session.
Parse the maximum program year value from the configuration.
Generate a list of ProgramYearData objects from 1 to the maximum program year.
Add a default ProgramYearData object with code 0 and value 'Not Applicable'.
Return the list of ProgramYearData objects.

business_rules: If the session is not provided, return a default set of ProgramYearData.
The list of program years includes a 'Not Applicable' option with code '0'.
validations: Ensure that the session is not null before attempting to retrieve configuration data.
Validate that the program year value parsed from the configuration is an integer.
calculations: Truncate the total years from the program details if program details are provided.
system_behavior: If no session is provided or configuration data cannot be retrieved, a default list of program years is returned with values from 1 to 5 and a 'Not Applicable' entry.
dependencies: Relies on Codes.CodeLookup to retrieve configuration data.
exceptions: If the maximum program year cannot be parsed to an integer, default values will be used.
